purpose: [OPTIMIZED] Finds artifacts matching a symbol name and returns their details.
parameters:
Works on canonical LIVE artifact facts.
Returns defining module, kind, consumer count, and consumer module list.
Supply ``symbol_name`` or alias ``symbol``. Input may be a symbol leaf name, exact active artifact ID (e.g. ``A855/4``), or exact full canonical artifact identity (e.g. ``pkg.mod::symbol``). Exact matches are preferred over partial matches. When a query is not found, bounded fuzzy suggestions from the active artifact registry may be returned in ``similar_candidates`` (up to 5 candidates with canonical identity, artifact ID, and similarity score). Fuzzy suggestions are suggestion-only and never auto-resolved; if no candidates meet the threshold, the legacy not-found fallback is preserved.
``limit`` bounds the response while ``total_matches``
and ``truncated`` describe omitted data. Consumers within every match are
bounded independently by ``evidence_limit``, always expose ``total`` and
``truncated``, and include ``items`` only when ``compact=False``. Pass
``None`` for all matches or all consumers. ``fields`` projects top-level keys
after compact shaping. Allowed values are ``query``, ``match_count``,
``total_matches``, ``truncated``, ``data_source``, and ``artifacts``.
behavior:
Resolution order:
1. Existing live symbol search (exact & partial substring matching).
2. Exact active artifact ID or full canonical identity via active registry.
3. Bounded fuzzy suggestions (score >= 0.75, max 5) on textual not-found.
4. Legacy not-found string fallback when no fuzzy candidates qualify.
usage_notes: LLM use: narrow ambiguous names before increasing ``limit``.
examples:
Searches by partial, case-insensitive match against the symbol part of
the artifact's full name (the part after '::', e.g. 'generate_graph'
matches 'generate_graph_analytics_report'), by exact artifact ID ('A855/4'), or by full canonical identity.
